To this end, we introduce a novel Hierarchical Table Prompt-based reprogramming framework, named HTP.
The HTP framework uniquely incorporates a four-level prompt structure, encompassing general, instance, cluster, and column levels.

Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools, exhibiting strong reasoning capabilities.
These methods often demand extensive manual maintenance and yet fail to fully comprehend the tabular data, leading to unsatisfactory performance.
Our empirical studies confirm that the HTP framework achieves state-of-the-art performance, marking an advancement in the field of data visualization and analysis.
